## Starter templates in ColorMag theme

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/starter-content-in-colormag-theme/>

What is a starter template? You might have this question, so in this article, we will explain start templates and how it works in the ColorMag theme.

Starter templates are pre-made sites that you could just change the content within and get a headstart when creating your site. There are many designs you can choose from, import and get started.

## How does it work?

After the installation of the ColorMag theme, within the ColorMag dashboard, you will see a Starter templates area:

Upon clicking on it, you will be prompted to install and activate the ThemeGrill Starter sites plugin. Simply click on install and activate. It is free, this plugin is required to import your desired template.

After this, you may simply select the desired template you would like to import.

You may choose from Gutenberg / Elementor templates. Once selected, you may quickly go through the steps and your desired template will start to be imported.

** Note: ** Templates with a PRO tag will require you to upgrade to ColorMag PRO, because those templates use premium elements. Checkout ColorMag PRO here

** Note: ** Importing a starter template will replace your current customizer settings, widgets, and content (depending on what you choose to import). It is recommended to use this on a fresh WordPress installation or take a full backup before importing.

After the process completes, your site should be ready. An exact copy of the template you chose.

## How to Install ColorMag Theme?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/install-colormag-theme/>

Getting started with the ColorMag theme is quite easy and quick. You can follow the methods below for installing the ColorMag theme on the WordPress Dashboard.

## Install ColorMag Theme

Generally, there are two methods of installing the ColorMag theme on your WordPress Dashboard. The methods are described below:

### Via ColorMag Page

- Go to ColorMag Page

- Click the **Download Now **button

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard **> **Appearance** > **Themes**

- Click on **Add New**

- Click on **Upload Theme** > **Choose File**

- Choose the **ColorMag** theme zip file from your local computer.

- Click on **Install Now** to start installing

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site.

ColorMag Theme Download via ThemeGrill site

### Via WordPress Dashboard

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to **Appearance > Themes **and click on **Add New**

- Search for – **ColorMag**

- Click on **Install** to run the installation.

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site

ColorMag Theme Download via Dashboard

## Upgrading from ColorMag Free to ColorMag Pro

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/upgrading-from-colormag-to-colormag-pro/>

If you are currently using the **ColorMag Free** and would like to upgrade to the ** ColorMag Pro ,** there are a few steps to follow. And the good news is **All your content, theme settings will remain as it is even after switching to the Pro theme**. You don’t need to redo what you have already built with the free version.

With the pro version of the ColorMag theme, you’ll find the features and customization option that includes **Colors**, **Typography**, **Design & Layouts**, **Background Options, Premium Demos,** and a lot more. For more information, you can check the article: ColorMag Free vs Pro .

- In order to upgrade the theme from ColorMag Free to ColorMag Pro , you can follow the steps listed below:

- Purchase the ColorMag Pro, after which you’ll receive a purchased email on your account.

- On the Purchase email, you’ll find access to the** ThemeGrill Account **. Sign in to the account.

- Go to **Downloads**.

- Download the **ColorMag Pro Theme**, and you will get the **colormap-pro-latest.zip** file.

After the above steps are completed, navigate to your WordPress Dashboard and follow the steps below:

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard **> **Appearance** > **Themes**.

- Click on **Add New**.

- Click on **Upload Theme** > **Choose File**.

- Choose the **ColorMag Pro** theme zip file from your local computer.

- Click on **Install Now** to start installing.

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site.

## How to Install ColorMag Pro Theme? **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/install-colormag-pro-theme/>

Getting started with the ** ColorMag Pro ** theme is simple and quick. You can follow the methods below for installing the theme on your WordPress Site

### Purchase and Download

- Purchase the ColorMag theme .

- Login to your ThemeGrill Account .

- Go to **Download s. **

- Download **ColorMag Pro** Theme, and you will get the **colormag-pro-latest.zip** file.

### Install and Activate

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard **> **Appearance** > **Themes**.

- Click on **Add New**.

- Click on **Upload Theme** > **Choose File**.

- Choose the **ColorMag Pro** theme zip file from your local computer.

- Click on **Install Now** to start installing.

- Click on the** Activate** button to make the theme work on your site.

### Activate License

- Go to your ThemeGrill Account .

- Go to **Licenses** and click on the **ColorMag** from the list.

- Copy the **License Key** by clicking on the Copy link.

- From the WordPress Dashboard, go to **Colormag > License.**

- Paste the license key there to get automatic updates and support.
